name: keysnag
description: Pre-push security gate for AI-built Next.js + Supabase apps: 13 checks covering leaked secrets, misconfiguration, broken access control, injection, payments/webhooks, backdoors, AI-endpoint abuse, dependency CVEs, storage/RLS, an exposed URL probe, cross-account access, and a pre-publish leak check for private names, local paths and commit history. Auto-runs on git commit/push in Claude Code, or from the CLI, a git hook, or any MCP client. Nothing leaves your machine except an optional OSV.dev CVE lookup.
